user.title: Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open [the AH login page]({login_url}) in Chrome, but **do not log in yet**.
2. Open DevTools (Cmd+Option+I / F12), tab **Network**, tick **Preserve log** and type `login-exit` in the filter box.
3. Log in (including the SMS code).
4. Right-click the `login-exit` line → Copy → **Copy URL**, and paste it below. The code is only valid for a few minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Albert Heijn again
